drafts.text:
everyone's AI launch this week says the same thing: a teammate, not a chatbot.

in amsterdam boutique hotels the missing teammate is the one nobody budgeted for. the one who answers direct-booking emails while the desk is busy.

that's the job i give a company brain.
drafts.rides: AlexFinn Grok Bot 1.0 'team bots you and your coworkers can interact with' (143.7K, 774 bm) + minchoi 'built to be an AI teammate, not just a chatbot' (36.5K) + minchoi Claude Meetings (10.4K)

drafts.text:
can someone give me a good reason why a small amsterdam boutique hotel shouldn't have one company brain that knows its rooms, its policies and its public reviews, and drafts the replies the desk never gets to?

that's what my free samples are built to show.
drafts.rides: tdinh_me 'Can someone give me a good reason why I shouldn't ... let claude code ... manage all of the infra' (22.8K, question hook, 18 bm)

drafts.text:
"if you want good taste, you have to eat."

same with hotel AI. before i build anything for an amsterdam boutique hotel i read its public reviews. the house voice is already in there.

the company brain just has to learn it. the desk keeps the taste.
drafts.rides: swyx quoting @jxnlco 'if you want good taste, you have to eat' (13.2K, 42 bm); rides rauchg 'still requires extraordinary human focus... and love' still climbing (138.2K, 556 bm)
